data.title: 贝塔 · 签售会幕后的专属签名私语
data.description: 盛大新书签售会的后台休息室内，贝塔身着华丽优雅的浅色礼裙坐在梳妆镜台前。手中羽毛笔悬在精装扉页上方，脸颊飞起微醺般的红晕，轻声询问少年想要写下怎样的专属情话。
data.location: cozy private backstage dressing room with vanity mirror and floral bouquets
data.action: sitting at dressing table, holding a feather quill pen poised over an open hardcover novel, blushing deeply, adoring upturned gaze, silver bob framing flushed face
data.lighting: warm dressing table vanity bulbs and golden afternoon window light
data.mood: flustered author sweet intimacy, romantic idol charm, fluttery excitement
data.promptProse: In a cozy backstage dressing room, silver-haired author Beta sits at a vanity table with quill pen in hand over her new book, blushing intensely with starry adoring eyes.
data.animaCaption: Poised with a feather quill over her novel in the backstage dressing room, she blushes with starry-eyed affection.
